test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

They missed their train / because they were waiting /on wrong platform. / They were on platform 3 instead of platform 8.

options.text: They were on platform 3 instead of platform 8

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase** "on wrong platform."**
 
• The correct phrase should be** "on the wrong platform"** or **"on the incorrect platform."**
 
• The use of the article **"the"** before **"wrong platform"** is necessary for grammatical correctness.
 
• **"Wrong platform" **needs to be modified with an article to indicate specificity.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** 'On wrong platform'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2) Because they were waiting:** This segment is grammatically correct and provides the reason for missing the train.
 
• **Option 3) They missed their train: **This segment is grammatically correct and provides the main action of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4) They were on platform 3 instead of platform 8:** This segment is grammatically correct and provides additional information about their location.
